eligibility.quote: Subscriber with strict policy refuses to subscribe less strict publishers.
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the public reproducer includes an incompatible-QoS diagnostic and endpoint information. E2: rosbridge_suite and robot_state_publisher exchange /tf; the subscription durability is an interface attribute, not deployment name wiring. E3: PAIR; the controller publisher is the environmental trigger, not the rejected peer. Stop at 6.

failed_conditions.quote: Actually my issue is not about Reliability policy, my problem is Durability policy.
failed_conditions.reason: Agree qos_durability and topic:/tf. The same comment identifies robot_state_publisher as a VOLATILE publisher and rosbridge_websocket as a TRANSIENT_LOCAL subscription; every listed endpoint is RELIABLE. Do not add a reliability condition from the first, subsequently corrected warning.

loudness.quote: [rosbridge_websocket]: New publisher discovered on topic '/tf', offering incompatible QoS. No messages will be received from it. Last incompatible policy: RELIABILITY
loudness.reason: A ROS incompatible-QoS diagnostic is explicitly present at endpoint discovery. Its initial policy label is not sufficient evidence for a separate reliability mismatch; the endpoint dump and clarification establish durability.

detection_stage.quote: [rosbridge_websocket]: New publisher discovered on topic '/tf', offering incompatible QoS. No messages will be received from it. Last incompatible policy: RELIABILITY
detection_stage.reason: The documented failure is detected at connect, not inferred from the location of the eventual edit.

resolution.quote: Yes this change resolves my issue.
resolution.reason: Agree recommended under the rubric requiring both resolved unit revisions. The reporter confirms success, but does not identify the robot_state_publisher revision. The PR diff changes any to all with a nonempty-publisher guard; a distro-derived 3.3.3 must not be represented as the reported binary revision.

notes: Primary issue, all issue/PR comments and PR #1023 diff read. No additional failed condition is established in the selected pair. Success is reported, but revision-qualified observed status is not established.
